Rules / Tool

SK9020 The binlog is stale for this file

The file on disk differs from what the recorded build compiled; the current text was substituted.

CategoryTool
Default severitysuggestion
ScopeCompilation
Needs a compilationno
Runs under --load=looseno
Cached per fileno — it reads the whole compilation
Fixno
Language version floor—
Since0.6

Why

Analysing what the build saw rather than what is on disk would report findings against code nobody has. Substituting the current text keeps the report about the working tree and says so.

When it does not fire

None; it is a comparison of file content against the compilation's recorded source list.
